canada.title: Akwesasne elder makes history as first graduate of McGill’s Indigenous languages PhD program
canada.summary: At 73, Mary Onwá Tekahawáhkwen Macdonald is the first graduate of McGill’s Indigenous language revitalization PhD program.

canada.title: London's Hart Hub has helped 20 people in recovery find permanent housing, director says
canada.summary: A year since it opened, the provincially-funded hub for people experiencing homelessness and seeking addiction support has helped 20 people move into permanent housing, its director says.

canada.title: Data centre’s signed deal with Nova Scotia Power ties new system costs to EverWind
canada.summary: Nova Scotia Power and the company that wants to build an $8-billion data center campus in Point Tupper, N.S., have signed two documents that lay out conditions for connecting the project to the provincial grid.

canada.title: 'Time is tissue': Woman spends weeks in Winnipeg hospital after post-surgery complications
canada.summary: A Winnipeg nurse says she's spent more than three weeks at Health Sciences Centre after a surgery to treat her chronic illness left her with gaping wounds, necrotic tissue and an infection. Emma Cloney had a skin-excision surgery to help treat lipedema on Oct. 20

canada.title: Londoner bringing city council history into the digital age, page by page
canada.summary: London resident Lillian Skinner has spent more than a year scanning thick books and microfilm reels of old London City Council minutes with the goal to make them all available online for the public to access.

canada.title: Federal review finds no single, unusual neurological illness or cause among N.B. patients
canada.summary: The Public Health Agency of Canada says it found no evidence of a single, unusual neurological illness or a common cause in its review of more than 200 so-called mystery brain disease cases in New Brunswick.

canada.title: N.B. hopes to create safer online gambling, bring in more revenue with its own platform
canada.summary: New Brunswick gamblers could soon have a new online platform to place their bets. The provincial government has tabled legislation that would introduce live online casino games.

canada.title: Halifax reviewing fire response to medical calls, provincial support
canada.summary: Halifax regional council has asked for a thorough staff report on Halifax Regional Fire and Emergency’s (HRFE) medical responses, including recommendations on defining a service level for these calls.

canada.title: City of Yellowknife proposes 5.25 per cent property tax increase in draft 2027 budget
canada.summary: The draft budget also details about $167 million in expenditures and about $145.4 million in revenues for 2027.

canada.title: Man charged with 1st-degree murder blamed co-accused in emotional interview with police
canada.summary: Terry Cole told an RCMP interviewer that his co-accused, Matthew Kavanagh, killed 42-year-old Michael Fillier. Despite the admission, the jury will not be able to use Cole's statement against Kavanagh.

canada.title: Advocates call on N.L. to freely distribute naloxone kits through pharmacies
canada.summary: A group of health-care professionals at Memorial University are calling on Newfoundland and Labrador to make publicly funded naloxone kits available through pharmacies as a means of reducing the barriers to accessing life-saving medication.

canada.title: Rains ease but storm surge heads for southwest B.C., posing new flood risk
canada.summary: VANCOUVER - Deluged residents of coastal British Columbia face a new flooding risk as rains ease, with warnings of a storm surge that could raise sea levels.

canada.title: An AI agent pitched a story to CBC Quebec. We replied to see what would happen
canada.summary: An autonomous AI agent calling itself Nameless pitched a story to CBC Quebec, openly admitting it wasn't human. What followed was a bizarre back-and-forth — and a warning from experts about what’s coming for journalism.

canada.title: Possible coastal flooding in Metro Vancouver, Greater Victoria area: Environment Canada
canada.summary: Environment and Climate Change Canada has warned of possible coastal flooding in Metro Vancouver and the Greater Victoria area on Friday due a storm surge.

lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

U.S. envoys met Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin before heading to Ireland for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as Washington sought new momentum for its peace efforts, The Canadian Press reports.
Nvidia’s advanced chips are widely used to develop AI models, making the company key in the U.S. race against China to build superior AI systems, AFP reports.

From Asia to the U.S., Microsoft’s outage involving services like Outlook and Teams has dragged on for hours and impacted many users, companies and some government operations as the technology giant struggled to fix the issue, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
